title: QA passes remain accepted across lane commits
when: An item lane advances after a QA method passed on an earlier lane commit.
need: Keep each method's run start commit. A completed passing run from the item's lane history remains accepted when the lane advances; no covering CI requirement or new capture is needed. Foreign commits, newer failures or incomplete attempts, stale configuration and target, subject proof and human review still block; required queue CI tests the final commit.
